website.function: Explain SENZ and take inquiries and quote requests. It does not sign people in, charge a card, grant a license, or run a product.

app.function: Run authorized SENZ products only after SENZ staff verify payment or an authorized agreement and the product is released for that customer.

rules: Senzapp owns technical capability, release evidence, entitlements and private operations.
Senz owns public copy, commercial approval and approved prices.
A visible card, account, request or quote never grants product access.
Public sale requires per-product technical and commercial gates; app.released alone grants nothing.
